name: osdi-skills
description: A 12-skill depth pack for OSDI submissions: venue fit, HotCRP submission audits, the no-rebuttal review process, USENIX open-access camera-ready, sysartifacts artifact evaluation, systems reproducibility, page-budget planning, writing style, related work, evaluation design, and cycle management. Grounded in the official OSDI '27 CFP, Requirements for Authors and HotCRP clock, the latest (OSDI '26) Call for Artifacts, and USENIX policy pages, re-verified on 2026-11-24.
